name: Leonard Mendoza
office: City of Commerce, Member of the City Council

items.text: Leonard Mendoza is a painter who previously served on the Commerce City Council and as its mayor. He was fired in 2014 from a city job for abusive behavior and dishonesty, a news report said. He says he balanced the budget and produced a $7.6 million surplus as mayor, and he pledges to address crime, spending, and affordable housing. As a councilmember in 2019, he voted against a cannabis ordinance and argued that a citywide vote should come first. Also in 2019, he was hospitalized after a physical fight with another council member at a government conference.
